description: Broadcasting House is the headquarters and registered office of the BBC in Portland Place, London. It is home to BBC Radio 3, BBC Radio 4, and BBC 7. (Nearby on Great Portland Street in Yalding House is BBC Radio 1 and BBC 1Xtra. Next door in Western House is BBC Radio 2 and BBC 6 Music.)
